sourceTitle: AI-enhanced CRISPR-Cas9 therapeutics: Advances in precision, safety, and delivery.
sourceAbstract: CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing has transformed biomedical research and is advancing toward clinical translation. The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) offers improved precision in guide RNA design, off-target prediction, and delivery optimization. This review synthesizes recent advances in CRISPR-Cas9 for medical applications, covering core mechanisms, engineered variants, base and prime editors, and therapeutic applications including CAR T-cell and CAR-NK engineering, genetic disorders, infectious diseases, and regenerative medicine. Delivery strategies are evaluated with emphasis on AI-driven optimization. AI applications are highlighted across deep learning architectures for guide RNA design, AI-designed nucleases such as OpenCRISPR-1, structure-guided and AI-assisted design of compact high-fidelity SaCas9 variants, reinforcement learning for pipeline optimization, and roles in CAR T-cell therapy and safety assessment. Safety challenges are examined, including off-target effects, chromosomal rearrangements, immunogenicity, and regulatory concerns. Future directions emphasize multi-scale modeling, explainable AI, clinical validation, and integration with synthetic biology, single-cell sequencing, organoids, and nanomaterials. The convergence of AI and CRISPR-Cas9 holds substantial potential for personalized medicine.
titleZh: 人工智能增强的CRISPR-Cas9治疗技术：精准性、安全性与递送的研究进展
abstractZh: CRISPR-Cas9基因组编辑已经改变了生物医学研究，并正向临床转化推进。人工智能（AI）的引入有助于提高向导RNA设计、脱靶预测与递送优化的精准性。本综述综合了CRISPR-Cas9医学应用的近期进展，涵盖其核心机制、工程化变体、碱基编辑器与先导编辑器（prime editors），以及嵌合抗原受体T细胞（CAR-T）和嵌合抗原受体自然杀伤细胞（CAR-NK）工程改造、遗传性疾病、感染性疾病及再生医学等治疗应用。文章评估了递送策略，重点关注由AI驱动的优化。所讨论的AI应用包括：用于向导RNA设计的深度学习架构；OpenCRISPR-1等由AI设计的核酸酶；结合结构指导与AI辅助，设计紧凑型、高保真SaCas9变体；利用强化学习优化流程；以及AI在CAR-T细胞治疗和安全性评估中的作用。综述还考察了脱靶效应、染色体重排、免疫原性及监管方面的安全挑战。未来方向重点包括多尺度建模、可解释AI、临床验证，以及与合成生物学、单细胞测序、类器官和纳米材料相结合。AI与CRISPR-Cas9的融合为个体化医疗带来了很大潜力。

sourceTitle: Engineering all human milk oligosaccharide fucosidic linkages in planta.
sourceAbstract: Human milk oligosaccharides (HMOs) are a component of breast milk which improve infant health outcomes by modulating immune responses, inhibiting pathogen adhesion, and promoting healthy gut microbiota. Although their effects are well-documented, few HMOs have been clinically or biochemically studied because only a handful of the simplest HMOs out of >200 species are currently possible to chemically synthesize or produce in microbes via metabolic engineering in microbial hosts. In contrast, plants are naturally adept at biosynthesizing a wide range of complex polysaccharides, and they have recently been established as a heterologous system for HMO production. However, much of the structural diversity of HMOs has not yet been reproduced in a plant, particularly fucosylations. Four fucosidic linkages can be found in fucosylated HMOs, but only Fucα1-2Gal has been biosynthesized in planta. Here, we screened bacterial fucosyltransferases using the model plant Nicotiana benthamiana to produce 3-fucosyllactose (Fucα1-3Glc), lacto-N-fucopentaose II (Fucα1-4GlcNAc), and lacto-N-fucopentaose III (Fucα1-3GlcNAc), demonstrating that all four fucosidic linkages can be made in planta. Just twelve glycosidic linkages make up all the HMOs found in breast milk, and our findings increase the number of linkages made in planta from seven to ten, greatly expanding the variety of HMOs accessible in a plant.
titleZh: 在植物体内工程化构建母乳寡糖的全部岩藻糖苷键类型
abstractZh: 母乳寡糖（HMOs）是母乳的一种组分，可通过调节免疫反应、抑制病原体黏附和促进健康的肠道微生物群，改善婴儿的健康结局。尽管这些作用已有充分报道，但接受过临床或生化研究的HMO种类仍很少，因为在超过200种HMO中，目前只有少数结构最简单的种类能够通过化学合成，或在微生物宿主中利用代谢工程生产。相比之下，植物天然具备生物合成多种复杂多糖的能力，近期也已被用作HMO生产的异源体系。不过，HMOs中的许多结构类型尚未在植物中构建出来，尤其是岩藻糖基化结构。岩藻糖基化HMO中存在4种岩藻糖苷键，但此前仅有Fucα1-2Gal在植物体内实现了生物合成。本研究以模式植物本氏烟草（Nicotiana benthamiana）筛选细菌来源的岩藻糖基转移酶，生产了3-岩藻糖基乳糖（3-fucosyllactose，Fucα1-3Glc）、lacto-N-fucopentaose II（Fucα1-4GlcNAc）和lacto-N-fucopentaose III（Fucα1-3GlcNAc），表明全部4种岩藻糖苷键均可在植物体内构建。母乳中的所有HMO仅由12种糖苷键构成，本研究将已能在植物体内构建的糖苷键种类从7种增加到10种，大幅扩展了可利用植物合成的HMO种类。
